text.ja: レベルセット円の2D平行移動：界面・面積・再初期化：解析的符号付き距離参照 phi(x,y,t)=sqrt((x-cx(t))^2+(y-cy(t))^2)-0.15; c(t)=(0.3+0.2*t,0.35+0.1*t). 全て無次元、領域[0,1]²、内部φ<0。与えた非圧縮の剛体運動だけを解き、円は境界から離れます。外側2層のゴースト値は各RK段階で解析解を指定します。周期境界ではなく、内部のφは数値更新します。出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1、物理Courant数max(|u|+|v|)Δt/Δx≤.35。
text.en: 2D level-set circle translation: interface, area and redistancing: analytic signed-distance reference phi(x,y,t)=sqrt((x-cx(t))^2+(y-cy(t))^2)-0.15; c(t)=(0.3+0.2*t,0.35+0.1*t). All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35.
